decisions.reason: The supplier defines open cells and relatively open faces. A finite union of closed simplices/facets cannot equal those sets. Subdivision now explicitly covers their closures with disjoint simplex interiors; vertex stars, means, fan geometry and uniform cubical examples retain their intended meaning.

The linear load used an undeclared function f with no integrability condition. Requiring f in L1(Omega) makes every cell load finite and preserves arbitrary finite cell-source vectors (realized by piecewise constant f). The nonlinear branch already assumes Lp-prime space-time data and is unchanged.

A nonzero local constant vector has zero gradient and all residuals zero, so the Remarks incorrectly called the local quantity a norm. It is now explicitly a seminorm with exactly the constants as kernel, hence a quotient norm. The lower bound, global zero-Dirichlet positive definiteness, monotonicity, conservation and affine flux calculation were already valid and are preserved.

The mesh supplier permits arbitrary interior centers; it does not imply midpoint centers as F1 suggested. The Example now explicitly chooses 1/4 and 3/4 and F1 attributes them to that choice. With those data the resistance equation gives c=9/5, samples 9/20 and 19/20, transmissibility 18/5 and outward flux -9/5, whereas arithmetic averaging gives -5. The numerical argument was sound for the intended choices.

False positive: f^n denotes the cell/time-averaged load f^n|K=f_K^n from F2, as confirmed by step 2.1 explicitly applying Jensen to cell/time averages. Thus sum_K |K| f_K^n (I_h z)_K = sum_K f_K^n integral_K z = integral_Omega f^n z exactly. Its Lp-prime norm obeys the existing Jensen bound. The mass pairing is likewise exact. Growth, mean-test stability and (p-1)p-prime=p prove the derivative bound; finite projections of companions prove compactness without a mesh/time coupling. No mathematical source change is warranted.

The direct weak-subsequence invocation did not cite or explicitly discharge its ultrafilter, DC and HB hypotheses. AC remains the sole assumed choice principle; added proved suppliers supply ultrafilters, DC/countable choice and dominated Hahn-Banach, now recorded in F4 and the extraction steps. Constant-in-time application of the existing space-time gradient lemma supplies H01 closure after compact L2 extraction, and scalar coordinate extraction supplies the physical vector-gradient subsequence. The pyramid volume factor d and cancellation estimate are unchanged and valid.
